Hi Emma,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and the items we agreed would be helpful to confirm next steps:

Pain points & goals:
- You need to minimize exposure of PII in logs while preserving debugability for production issues.
- Retention and audit access requirements driven by regulatory & internal policy (data retention 7 years for some records).
- Need to ensure encryption-at-rest and KMS-backed key management, plus exportable audit logs for audits.

Current stack you mentioned:
- Ingest via AWS API Gateway -> internal services -> Snowflake for analytics
- Existing logging pipeline: CloudWatch + S3 (retention 1 year default)

Success criteria for pilot:
- No raw PII in long-term logs (PII redaction or tokenization before durable storage)
- Configurable retention windows and ability to export audit logs on demand
- KMS/HSM integration for keys and role-based access to logs

Redwood capabilities (high level):
- We support per-request configurable logging controls (full, minimal, none) and can redact tokens server-side before persistence.
- Audit logs and request-level metadata are available via the Console and can be exported to S3 or pushed to your SIEM. Retention is configurable; enterprise contracts support extended retention windows.
- We integrate with customer KMS for envelope encryption and support access controls/audit trails.

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf (high-level) and Data-Retention-Policy.md (config options)

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the list of PII fields you need redacted (names, SSNs, account numbers, ...)?
2) Would you like a security deep-dive with our Solutions Engineering + Security team next week? I can propose times.
3) Please share any security questionnaire you'd like us to return.

Hi Emma — great questions. Quick answers inline and next steps.

- PII list: we can support redaction for names, emails, dob, SSN, full account numbers and payment tokens. Last-4 storage is supported when configured.
- Redaction before storage: two options:
  1) Client-side redaction/tokenization: you run a lightweight SDK that replaces PII before sending. This is the highest assurance and doesn't create raw PII on our side.
  2) Server-side redaction pipeline: we can run a configured redaction step prior to durable logs. We provide verifiable audit evidence (hashing + deletion proofs) and a replayable pipeline for your security team to validate.
- Retention: Default request logs retention is 30 days. For enterprise customers we offer configurable retention windows up to 7+ years via our Dedicated/Private plans and can export to your S3 for long-term archival.
- Audit logs & exports: Audit logs are available in the Redwood Console, can be exported to S3 or forwarded to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog). We generate immutable export artefacts suitable for audit evidence.
- KMS: We support AWS KMS BYOK for envelope encryption; keys never leave your account when configured.

Immediate items:
- We can fill out your security questionnaire. Rishi — can you own the questionnaire and the security deep-dive scheduling?
- Proposed slot: Wed Aug 12 or Thu Aug 13, 2:00 PM PST (I know you said afternoon). Do either work?

If that looks good I'll get Rishi to schedule and attach a short tech note on the redaction pipeline.

Thanks again,
